# online-courses.club

> > A curated marketplace for premium online courses in VFX, digital art, character design, and animation through group-buy collaborations with platforms like Coloso, Gumroad, and Rebelway.

online-courses.club aggregates and distributes affordable access to professional creative courses through group-buy models, featuring instructors from major platforms and studios. The site specializes in digital illustration, 3D modeling, VFX, character design, and animation training across 1000+ course listings.

## Key Topics

- Character Design
- Digital Illustration
- VFX Training
- Group-Buy Courses
- Houdini
- Nuke
- Anime Illustration
- Color Theory

- Coloso

- 3D Modeling
- Impasto Painting
- Pixel Art

- [01 Professional compositing techniques (EN) [Gumroad, Aitor Echeveste, Group-Buy]](https://online-courses.club/01-professional-compositing-techniques-en-gumroad-aitor-echeveste-group-buy): Professional Nuke compositing course by Aitor Echeveste through Gumroad group-buy.
- [Practice Makes Perfect: Mastering Anime Character Illustrations [Coloso, Lunarmimi, Group-buy]](https://online-courses.club/practice-makes-perfect-mastering-anime-character-illustrations-coloso-lunarmimi-group-buy): Comprehensive anime character illustration course by Lunarmimi via Coloso covering techniques and fundamentals.
- [Marvel's The Art of Storytelling [Marvel, Proko, Group-Buy]](https://online-courses.club/marvels-the-art-of-storytelling-marvel-proko-group-buy): Professional storytelling and comic creation course by Marvel instructors through Proko.
- [Charming Characters and Romance Scene Illustration [Coloso, Jii, Group-Buy]](https://online-courses.club/charming-characters-and-romance-scene-illustration-coloso-jii-group-buy): Character and romance scene illustration course by Jii via Coloso with focus on expressive character design.
- [Master Vibrant Pixel Art and Dynamic Animations [Coloso, Nanamiyuki, GBC Dub]](https://online-courses.club/master-vibrant-pixel-art-and-dynamic-animations-%e8%89%b2%e5%bd%a9%e3%81%8c%e9%9a%9b%e7%ab%8b%e3%81%a4%e3%83%94%e3%82%af%e3%82%bb%e3%83%ab%e3%82%a2%e3%83%bc%e3%83%88%e3%81%ae%e5%9f%ba%e7%a4%8e): Pixel art and animation fundamentals course by Nanamiyuki via Coloso with dynamic animation techniques.
